title: requirements.txt pins pydantic-email-validation==0.2.0 which does not exist on PyPI
description: backend/requirements.txt lists pydantic-email-validation==0.2.0. Verified against PyPI: no distribution with that name exists (pip index returns 'No matching distribution found'). The intended package for Pydantic v2 EmailStr (used by models/lead.py:1,24) is `email-validator`. Consequences: (1) a fresh `pip install -r requirements.txt` fails during dependency resolution, blocking deployment (availability); (2) if a malicious actor ever publishes a package with that name, an automated install could pull it - a typo-squat/dependency-confusion risk; (3) email-validator itself is NOT declared, so the EmailStr dependency is undeclared even though models import it.
impact: Deployment failure in clean environments; supply-chain exposure to package-name squatting; undeclared runtime dependency.
mitigation: Replace `pydantic-email-validation==0.2.0` with `email-validator>=2.0` (plus a pinned exact version); verify the full requirements set installs cleanly in an empty venv; consider hashing/pinning and a lockfile.
